planets.name: TOI-771 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-771 with a 2.33-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-771 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-771. Its orbit and size follow Lacedelli et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
